lines: Along the loop line where breath runs out
Beneath a faded star and a darkened sky
Somewhere along the way I lost myself
Searching for a recipe for how to live, aren't I?
That lost thing called wonder
Let's go reclaim it, that worn-out dream
Like the way I buried it in sand as a child
I'll offer this song to the me of ten years from now
Laugh, cry, sing — become a flower
Bloom in full glory, someday, overflowing with light
Even if it's bitter, I'll surely take it in
Without worrying about the future
Countless times, over and over
I called your name
I wonder if you're smiling somewhere
The voices we let loose into the night sky
Vanish into the noise
And gently wrap around us
I've grown sick of these repeating days
Why not try shining, brilliantly, once and for all?
Rather than a dried flower blooming for eternity, we
Should become cherry blossoms, scattering but wholehearted
Laugh, cry, sing — become a flower
Bloom in full glory, someday, overflowing with light
Even if it's bitter, I'll surely take it in
Without worrying about the future
Countless times, over and over
I called your name
The warmth left in my palm
What we swore back then — our
Voices vanish into the noise
I stand frozen in the town where I was with you
Before I knew it, I'd grown afraid of being hurt
Still a bud, unchanged
I keep searching for the place where the light falls
Tomorrow too, surely
How far do I have to go before we can laugh together?
Freedom, hope, dreams — are they really
As wonderful as I imagine? Do they really shine?
Hold the future in this chest
Countless times, over and over
I called your name
I wonder if you're smiling somewhere
The voices we let loose into the night sky
Vanish into the noise
And gently wrap around us
